boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UIC rituals, recognitions, and recurring campus practices—from torch ceremonies to nursing uniforms in a pool.

cards.title: Light the Flame Before the Game
cards.subtitle: UIC Athletics and university gatherings
cards.notes: Watch for the symbolic torchbearer entrance at a major UIC gathering or Flames home basketball game; the torch lights a cauldron as the school song plays.
cards.short_summary: A distinguished UIC community member carries a torch onto the arena floor and ignites the ceremonial cauldron.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC says Lighting of the Flame began in 1998; torchbearers light a cauldron at major university gatherings or before Flames men's home basketball games.
cards.access_notes: Typically staged at a large university gathering or before a UIC Flames men's home basketball game; check the event schedule.

cards.title: Sign Your Incoming Class Banner
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation
cards.notes: At Convocation, add your name to the incoming-class banner and join the official welcome activities for new UIC undergraduates.
cards.short_summary: New students mark the beginning of their UIC careers by signing their class banner.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC identifies signing the Class of 2028 banner as one of its Flames traditions at New Student Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Presented as part of New Student Convocation for incoming undergraduate students; follow current orientation communications for participation details.

cards.title: Begin as a Flame With a Torch Lighting
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation
cards.notes: Attend the official undergraduate welcome ceremony to see the torch-lighting tradition alongside the class banner signing and group photo.
cards.short_summary: Torch lighting is part of UIC's formal welcome for new undergraduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC describes torch lighting as a Flames tradition at its New Student Convocation, the official beginning of new undergraduates' UIC journey.
cards.access_notes: Part of New Student Convocation; attendance and timing are set through current new-student programming.

cards.title: Become Part of the UIC Circle
cards.subtitle: Harrison Field, Harrison and Halsted streets
cards.notes: Register for Convocation and join the coordinated campus photo moment: students, faculty, staff, alumni, and friends form the UIC circle mark together.
cards.short_summary: The Convocation crowd creates a large living version of UIC's circle mark.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC's 2026 Convocation announcement invites participants to form the largest UIC human circle mark to welcome new students.
cards.source_title: Convocation 2026: One Circle. One UIC. | UIC College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event was scheduled for Harrison Field; participation requires registration for the current Convocation program.

cards.title: Return in Gold 50 Years Later
cards.subtitle: December Commencement
cards.notes: Eligible alumni returning for their 50th graduation anniversary can take part in the Golden Graduates Celebration and wear golden regalia at December Commencement.
cards.short_summary: UIC honors 50-year alumni milestones with gold regalia and a commencement return.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC says its annual Golden Graduates Celebration honors alumni 50 years after graduation; Golden Graduates wear golden regalia during December Commencement.
cards.access_notes: For alumni celebrating the 50th anniversary of graduation; UIC directs eligible alumni to the current Golden Graduates information.

cards.entity_name: Golden Apple Award for Teachers in the College of Medicine
cards.title: Honor a Medical Teacher With a Golden Apple
cards.subtitle: UIC College of Medicine
cards.notes: Learn the long-running College of Medicine recognition by watching for Golden Apple Award announcements and honorees in UIC medical community programming.
cards.short_summary: A College of Medicine teaching honor that UIC identifies as one of its older traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC's Dean of Students history page names the Golden Apple Award for teachers in the College of Medicine as a tradition going back more than half a century.
cards.source_title: UIC History, Traditions, Symbols | Office of the Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: This recognition is specific to the UIC College of Medicine; consult its current announcements for nomination or ceremony information.

cards.entity_name: Graduating Nurses' Chicago Illini Union Pool Jump
cards.title: Celebrate Nursing Convocation With a Pool Jump
cards.subtitle: Chicago Illini Union pool
cards.notes: Observe rather than imitate unless you are part of the graduating nursing cohort and the current ceremony specifically includes the supervised tradition.
cards.short_summary: UIC documents graduating nurses entering the Chicago Illini Union pool in their student-nurse uniforms after convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC's Dean of Students history page says graduating nurses celebrate convocation by jumping into the Chicago Illini Union pool wearing student-nurse uniforms.
cards.source_title: UIC History, Traditions, Symbols | Office of the Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: A graduation-related nursing tradition; do not enter a pool except through the formally supervised current ceremony and facility rules.

cards.title: Join One of UIC’s Oldest Student Traditions
cards.subtitle: Chancellor's Student Service and Leadership Awards
cards.notes: Students with sustained campus involvement can review current nomination requirements and seek induction through the Chancellor's Student Service and Leadership Awards process.
cards.short_summary: The Activities Honorary Society recognizes deeply involved undergraduates through an annual UIC induction.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC says its Activities Honorary Society was chartered at Navy Pier in 1950 and is one of the oldest traditions at UIC.
cards.source_title: 52nd Annual Chancellor's Student Service and Leadership Awards program
cards.access_notes: UIC's awards program states that no more than 15 students are selected annually; use the current awards cycle for eligibility and nominations.

cards.title: Make a Week of Flames Homecoming
cards.subtitle: UIC campus and affiliated event venues
cards.notes: Follow the current Homecoming calendar for school-spirit events, alumni activities, community programming, and the coordinated campus celebration.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s Homecoming brings students, alumni, fans, and community members together around school history and spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC's Center for Student Involvement says Homecoming is an annual tradition where alumni, students, fans, and community members honor a school's traditions and history.
cards.source_title: Annual Programs & Events | UIC Center for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: Annual programming varies by year; consult UIC's current Homecoming schedule for locations and entry details.

cards.title: Celebrate International Day in April
cards.subtitle: UIC campus
cards.notes: Look for April International Day programming and take part in the campus celebration of UIC's cultural diversity through officially scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: UIC identifies International Day as its April celebration of the campus community's cultural diversity.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC's Dean of Students history page states that students celebrate UIC's cultural diversity at International Day in April.
cards.source_title: UIC History, Traditions, Symbols | Office of the Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: UIC identifies this celebration as occurring in April; consult current campus calendars for its program and location.
